title: Dog Laugh
blurb: Dogs really do have a laugh: a breathy, rhythmic panting huff that behavioural researchers have recorded and then played back to shelter dogs, measurably calming them down. This clip is the classic version, and it is uncanny, sitting right on the line between an innocent pant and open mockery. The internet, inevitably, went with the second reading. Play it whenever somebody falls over and is definitely, definitely fine. Nobody in the room believes the dog is being sympathetic.
origin: A recording of the breathy panting sound identified as canine laughter.
